summary: Nocopi Technologies filed an 8-K reporting its wholly owned subsidiary's acquisition of substantially all assets of Polymeric U.S., Inc.'s specialty ink and coating business. Consideration totaled $2,650,000, comprising $1,900,000 cash ($1,750,000 paid at closing, $150,000 holdback), assumption of specified liabilities, and issuance of 500,000 Nocopi common shares. Closing occurred simultaneously on May 18, 2026. The board authorized the agreement; no advisor named. The holdback secures working capital adjustments and indemnification, released in tranches over 18 months. Watch for post-closing working capital resolution and any earnout or indemnity claims affecting final economics.
